text:
The encouragement of roadside vegetation has proven to have some effect upon noise abatement. Selective mowing of grass for those specified areas which may be necessary for motorist sight distances also reduces costly expenditures. Supplemental contracts for planting trees and shrubs will be let upon completion of initial roadway construction after seed has established a primary ground cover. Plant species are selected to be indigenous and hardy for survival in the immediate area of vehicle salt spray and exhaust emissions.
A mutual effort on the part of all agencies involved in the planning, construction, and subsequent maintenance of the proposed facility will insure that the human environment will not only be protected from harm, but in the long run, will be substantially improved.
